glosses: cathedral (relating to the office of a bishop or an archbishop)

examples.en: The spire of the cathedral collapsed.

examples.text: Esta catedral foi construída há mais de quatro séculos.
examples.en: This cathedral was built more than four centuries ago.

examples.text: A catedral data da Idade Média.
examples.en: The cathedral dates back to the Middle Ages.

examples.text: O órgão desta catedral é de ébano, claro, menos os tubos.
examples.en: The organ of this cathedral is made of ebony, except the pipes of course.
